system_api: remove STORAGE_CRYPTOHOME_DOWNLOADS from concierge API User's Downloads directory is not accessible to concierge/crosvm (crosvm user does not have access to chronos' files), so there is no reason of having this option as storage location for images. The plan is to pass an image's file descriptor if access outside of /home/root/<cryptohome_id>/{crosvm|pvm} is needed. This removes STORAGE_CRYPTOHOME_DOWNLOADS and reorders the rest so STORAGE_CRYPTOHOME_PLUGINVM moves over by one. It is OK as Chrome is not using STORAGE_CRYPTOHOME_PLUGINVM yet. By default Chrome OS build system adds the CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS as below: -fno-exceptions -fno-unwind-tables -fno-asynchronous-unwind-table They prevent Android from showing up the backtrace.
